title: Soap Dish Wall Mount 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Brass Soap Dishes | Allied Brass
description:
Clear the sink ledge and keep bar soap where it belongs with a wall-mounted soap dish. This soap dish (also called a wall soap holder or wall soap tray) installs as a wall mount accessory to keep your bathroom vanity looking neat while complementing transitional bathroom hardware.

Highlights:
- Reduce countertop clutter: wall mount placement keeps soap off the counter and organized at the sink
- Durable metal build: solid brass construction designed for daily bathroom use
- Coordinated look: matches other pieces in the Brass Soap Dishes collection
- Finish flexibility: offered in multiple designer finish options to suit versatile bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product: wall-mounted soap dish / wall hanging soap holder
- Material: solid brass (brass construction)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 4.5 x 3 x 3.5 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 inches
- Shipping weight: 2 lbs
- Assembly: assembled in the U.S.A.
